description: Source code for a Bluetooth ISO receive demo using Zephyr RTOS, involving periodic advertising synchronization, BIG sync, and ISO channel handling.

methods.name: blink_timeout
methods.description: Handles LED blinking timeout, toggling LED state.

methods.name: data_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse Bluetooth advertisement data, extracting device name.

methods.name: phy2str
methods.description: Converts PHY type enum to human-readable string.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a scan result, processes advertisement info.

methods.name: sync_cb
methods.description: Callback for when periodic advertising sync is established.

methods.name: term_cb
methods.description: Callback for when periodic advertising sync is terminated.

methods.name: recv_cb
methods.description: Callback for receiving data over periodic advertising sync.

methods.name: biginfo_cb
methods.description: Callback for receiving BIG info, indicating availability of broadcast streams.

methods.name: iso_recv
methods.description: Handles incoming ISO data packets on a channel.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, scanning, sync, and handling ISO streams.
